Ticket HW-412
Opened by: Dag Quenby
Status: open

The floodlight over the east lot cuts out around midnight and comes back near four. The night
crew has been parking in the covered spaces in the meantime.

Facilities replied that the lot is closed for resurfacing and the light runs on a timer. The
timer was not set by facilities, and nobody has said who set it.
